name: Mysterious Girl
source:
The first person Hao-Chen meets in an abandoned building, who is in charge of guarding him and contacting his family for ransom. She has an aggressive personality, often mocking and even beating him. For some reason, she has a deep-rooted hatred against the rich, yet also has a soft side towards her friends and family.

[spoiler]Her last name is Huang I-yu.[/spoiler]

[Taken from [url=https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/019/934/677/3dc88ad2bf1ee25cad395332f678962e_original.png?w=680&fit=max&v=1516596621&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2efeeb2d13ab4f82a742dd942b950c76]Kickstarter Description[/url]]
